reRatificationCount derivation. Read the Decision list via readGateDecisions. If the list is not state "ok", the count is 0 (unreadable is not an amendment; invalid ledgers already surface elsewhere). Consider only entries where gate is approve, decision is permit, artifact is spec or plan, and fingerprint is a non-empty string. Group by artifact. Walk each group in list order (ledger write order). The first fingerprinted permit for that artifact is the baseline and counts 0. Each later fingerprinted permit whose fingerprint differs from the previous fingerprinted permit in that group adds 1. Sum spec and plan. Identical fingerprints in a row add 0 (no-op re-approve). Unfingerprinted entries, unnamed-artifact entries, refuse Decisions, and apply/archive gates do not participate and do not reset the previous fingerprint. Forced permits participate when they carry artifact and fingerprint. This is a transition count, not distinct-set-minus-one: A then B then A is 2, not 1. The brief's "distinct minus one" undercounts a revert; "a re-approval whose fingerprint differs" is the event.

supersedeChainDepth derivation. Reverse-walk Replacement pointers across active/ and archive/. A predecessor of B is a bundle whose spec.xml (else plan.xml, if spec has no pointer) names B via the same three shapes grammar already accepts (src/artifact/grammar.ts:1438-1445): a child C-* tag, <Replacement> text, or <ReplacementChange> text matching ANCHOR_PATTERNS.change. If spec and plan both name a pointer and they differ, spec wins. Depth(B) is 0 when B has no predecessor; otherwise 1 + max depth of its predecessors. Guard cycles with a visited set and treat a cycle as depth 0 from the repeated node so the walk terminates. Do not inherit reRatificationCount along the chain: that number is per bundle, which is how pilot's budget will be. Chain depth is accumulated cost under today's supersede regime; the surviving tip of a two-step chain reports 2. Do not export grammar's replacementChangeIds; re-read XML in ledger.ts. Do not add M-GRAMMAR to this bundle.
